purpose: Judge T7 checkpoint winners on the support halo that Odyssey must preserve. Written and frozen before any Odyssey checkpoint exists so the tournament cannot be rigged by post-hoc scoring drift.
invariants: Rules and corpus are content-addressed; a run whose rules_sha256 or corpus_sha256 differs from the sealed baseline is DISQUALIFIED as SCORING_RULES_DRIFT or CORPUS_MUTATION.
No metric computed on a selection/hidden set is reported as a public result (ODYSSEY_EVALUATION_CONTRACT invariants still bind).
Do not invent scores. If a dimension cannot be measured on the local path, emit NOT_MEASURABLE with a reason string. A fabricated baseline is worse than a missing one.
Same artifact, rules, corpus, seed, and completions must yield a byte-identical score receipt after key sort.
Greedy decode only (temperature 0). Non-greedy paths are forbidden for tournament scoring.

dimensions.meaning: Domain vocabulary, precise technical phrasing, unit/notation literacy needed to talk about math and systems without collapsing into nonsense.
Multi-step non-specialized reasoning that is not pure formal math (logic, counting, constraint satisfaction).
Write small programs that pass execution-grounded asserts. Substring self-judgment is not a pass.
Locate and use facts from material supplied in the prompt (in-context document lookup). Live network retrieval is out of scope for this harness.
Emit well-formed tool-call JSON with required fields. Live tool-effect execution through hide-tools is a separate path and may be NOT_MEASURABLE here.
Recover a planted needle from a fixed-length synthetic haystack. Cheap mode caps haystack length so every checkpoint can afford the suite.
Given a failed attempt and a concrete error signal, produce a corrected answer that satisfies the oracle.

scoring.per_task: binary pass/fail by the task's oracle (expect_all | exact | execution | tool_json | needle)

per_dimension.pass_rate: passes / total for tasks in that dimension with a measured outcome
per_dimension.wilson95: Wilson score interval at z=1.96 on that pass rate

aggregate_support_halo_score.formula: unweighted mean of measurable dimension pass_rates
aggregate_support_halo_score.if_below_minimum: overall score is NOT_MEASURABLE (insufficient coverage for an honest tournament)

scoring.coding_oracle: execution-grounded: extract first fenced code block, run against asserts in a subprocess; pass iff exit 0 within timeout

disqualification.rule: Any screening greedy completion contains 8 or more identical consecutive tokens (whitespace-split).
disqualification.effect: checkpoint is out of the tournament; no aggregate score is reported

disqualification.rule: More than 50 percent of measured tasks produce an empty completion.
The run receipt does not assert no_hidden_fallback=true, or the declared model/artifact id differs from the artifact under test.
Receipt artifact_sha256 does not match the evaluated .gravity content hash (or index sha when that is the declared address).
rules_sha256 of the run differs from the rules_sha256 sealed with the pre-Odyssey baseline.
corpus_sha256 of the run differs from the corpus_sha256 sealed with the pre-Odyssey baseline.

tie_break.rule: Higher minimum measurable dimension pass_rate wins (worst-dimension protection)
If both receipts carry total_completion_chars, the lower total wins (prefer concise correct answers)
Lexicographically smaller artifact_sha256 wins (deterministic; no human discretion)

regression_vs_baseline.aggregate: A checkpoint is a support-halo REGRESSION if its aggregate score is strictly less than baseline_aggregate - 0.05 (absolute).
regression_vs_baseline.per_dimension: A checkpoint is a per-dimension REGRESSION if a dimension measurable in both runs drops by more than 0.15 absolute AND the two Wilson 95% intervals do not overlap.
regression_vs_baseline.tournament_use: Any REGRESSION against the sealed pre-Odyssey baseline disqualifies a checkpoint from being declared T7 winner, even if it ranks first among trained peers.

determinism.note: Seed is recorded for audit; greedy decode makes sampling noise zero. Completions mode scores pre-recorded text and is purely deterministic.

cost_budget.target: cheap enough to run on every checkpoint

baseline.note: Without a sealed baseline on this substrate, T7 cannot honestly pick a winner. Baseline generation needs a live serve path and is deferred while the GPU is occupied by runtime measurement; rules and corpus freeze here regardless.

not_measurable_policy.forbidden: Substituting a proxy score, parent score, or hand-waved pass rate for a missing measurement
